title: Add GitHub issue labels with AI using your rules
h1: ask ai to add the right labels to a github issue
description: Apply named labels to a GitHub issue with AI. Keep spelling controlled: this action creates missing labels and does not ask under the sending setting.
keyword: add github issue labels with ai
keywords: ai add labels to github issue
answer: give your bot a github issue and a list of label names, and it can add those labels to that issue. names that do not already exist are created, so a spelling mistake can add a new label rather than fail. adding a label is a change, and changes don't ask first. give the bot your exact list of labels, and say "ask me first" if you want to approve each one.
og_line: consistent labels start with exact names.
what:
paste the issue link, or describe the issue and let the bot find it. it reads the issue, then adds only the labels you allow.

this is an add operation, not a request to replace every existing label. because missing labels get created, a typo like "acessibility" becomes a real new label. give the bot your allowed names and definitions rather than asking it to invent a useful label for every report.
uses: add needs-reproduction to a named report after you confirm its steps are missing
mark a keyboard-navigation report with your existing accessibility label
apply the agreed component label to a bug in one specific part of the product
add a review label after an owner asks for another look

routine.message: when a github issue opens in tamsin-tickets/box-office, read it and propose either the existing label access-check for keyboard access reports or no label. show me the issue number and the text supporting your choice here, and ask me before you change anything. after i confirm, add only access-check and report the labels returned. never create alternative spellings, remove labels or label issues in another repository.
routine.when: when an issue opens in tamsin-tickets/box-office
routine.needs: github connected with read and write access; issue reading and label addition allowed in the named repository
routine.output:
label proposal for tamsin-tickets/box-office #28

reporter: zuleika
evidence: the date picker cannot be reached with the keyboard.
proposed addition: access-check

other labels will be left alone. awaiting your confirmation.

steps: connect the repository account through **Connected apps** and tell the bot the exact label names and what each means.
enable **read and write** for label addition, limiting its action list to issue reading and the changes this job needs.
try one known issue and require a proposal before the first label call.
check the labels on that issue in github, then send the routine message above. use **Pause** if your labels change.
watch: missing names are created automatically. do not rely on a typo being rejected.
a label request needs the issue number together with its repository and owner. a title match alone is not the destination.
adding labels doesn't ask first; your sending setting doesn't cover it. keep "ask me first" in the routine if labels set off work for your team.
github issue events arrive at once, but a bot on your own sleeping computer cannot act then. dusk cloud keeps routines running on time.

faq.q: will this replace the labels already on the issue?
faq.a: this action adds the requested labels. if the job is only to add one, say that existing labels must remain alone.

faq.q: what happens if the label does not exist?
faq.a: the action creates it. give the bot the exact names it may use, so you don't end up with "bug", "bugs" and "bug-report".
